steps: Войди в Фиту на телефоне и разреши нужные категории Apple Health или Health Connect.

Show today’s readiness alongside sleep and heart rate.

sections.heading: What can you ask first?
paragraphs: You: “Look at my sleep, heart rate and workouts this week. What changed, and what should I pay attention to today?”

sections.heading: Which data do you share?
paragraphs: Choose activity, sleep, heart and workouts, together or separately. Your FITA conversations and memory stay separate from the MCP snapshot. Enable heart and sleep to discuss readiness.
Switch access off in your profile to delete the server snapshot and revoke connections. Manage the external assistant’s conversation history in its own settings.

sections.heading: How does the context come together?

Turn off AI assistant access in your profile. FITA deletes the server snapshot and revokes connections.
